repo.description: COgnitive Real-Time EXecution System - Enterprise Code Intelligence Platform

overview.summary: Enterprise Code Intelligence Dashboard powered by CORTEX LENS
overview.business_summary: CORTEX is an enterprise-grade code intelligence platform that provides real-time code analysis, security scanning, and automated refactoring recommendations. Built on a Model Context Protocol (MCP) first architecture, it orchestrates 23 specialized modules to deliver comprehensive repository insights. The platform serves as the central nervous system for engineering teams, enabling proactive code quality management, security vulnerability detection, and architectural compliance monitoring across the entire codebase.
key_findings: Strong overall health score with excellent test coverage
Active MCP server providing 15+ production tools
Security posture is solid with minor improvements needed
Code quality metrics above industry benchmarks

vulnerabilities.title: Potential SQL Injection in Query Builder

use_cases.title: Automated Code Review
use_cases.description: Enable developers to receive instant feedback on code quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practice violations during pull request reviews.
use_cases.business_value: Reduces code review time by 40% and catches 85% of common issues before human review.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Uses LENS analyzer with configurable rule sets. Integrates with GitHub Actions for PR automation.

use_cases.title: Security Vulnerability Scanning
use_cases.description: Continuously scan codebase for security vulnerabilities, outdated dependencies, and compliance issues with OWASP standards.
use_cases.business_value: Proactive security posture reduces incident response time and compliance audit preparation by 60%.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Integrates with Bandit, Safety, and custom OWASP rule engine. Results feed into security dashboard.

use_cases.title: Technical Debt Tracking
use_cases.description: Identify, quantify, and prioritize technical debt across the codebase with actionable remediation recommendations.
use_cases.business_value: Enables data-driven sprint planning with clear ROI calculations for debt reduction efforts.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Combines code complexity metrics, TODO tracking, and architectural analysis for comprehensive debt scoring.

use_cases.title: Architecture Compliance Monitoring
use_cases.description: Ensure codebase adheres to defined architectural patterns, layer boundaries, and dependency rules.
use_cases.business_value: Prevents architectural erosion and maintains system maintainability over time.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Uses AST analysis to verify layer dependencies and pattern compliance. Violations trigger alerts.

use_cases.title: Onboarding New Repositories
use_cases.description: Automatically analyze and generate comprehensive documentation for new repositories joining the CORTEX ecosystem.
use_cases.business_value: Reduces onboarding time from days to hours with automated analysis and documentation generation.
use_cases.implementation_notes: MCP-exposed onboarding orchestrator generates JSON manifests consumed by SPA dashboards.

use_cases.title: Dependency Impact Analysis
use_cases.description: Assess the impact of upgrading or changing dependencies across the codebase before making changes.
use_cases.business_value: Reduces failed deployments by 70% through proactive impact assessment.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Traces dependency usage throughout codebase and simulates upgrade impacts.

use_cases.title: Test Coverage Optimization
use_cases.description: Identify critical code paths lacking test coverage and prioritize testing efforts based on risk.
use_cases.business_value: Maximizes test ROI by focusing coverage on highest-risk code paths.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Combines coverage data with complexity and change frequency for risk-based prioritization.

use_cases.title: Performance Bottleneck Detection
use_cases.description: Identify potential performance issues through static analysis of complexity, database queries, and resource usage patterns.
use_cases.business_value: Catches performance issues before production, reducing incident rates by 50%.
use_cases.implementation_notes: Analyzes query patterns, loop complexity, and memory allocation patterns.

lens.architecture_summary: The codebase follows a clean layered architecture with clear separation between API, business logic, and data access layers. MCP-first design ensures all functionality is exposed through well-defined tool interfaces. The orchestrator pattern provides flexible workflow composition.
recommendations: Consider extracting LensAnalyzer into smaller focused analyzers
Implement caching layer for frequently accessed analysis results
Add circuit breaker pattern for external service calls

recommendations.title: Extract Query Builder Module
recommendations.description: The query_builder.py contains multiple concerns. Extract SQL generation into dedicated module.
recommendations.impact: Improves testability and reduces security risk

recommendations.title: Decompose LensAnalyzer Class
recommendations.description: God class with 1500+ lines. Split into SecurityAnalyzer, QualityAnalyzer, and ArchitectureAnalyzer.
recommendations.impact: Major improvement in maintainability and testing

recommendations.title: Implement Caching Strategy
recommendations.description: Repeated analysis of unchanged files. Add intelligent caching with invalidation.
recommendations.impact: 50% reduction in analysis time for incremental runs

recommendations.title: Standardize Error Handling
recommendations.description: Inconsistent error handling across modules. Implement centralized exception hierarchy.
recommendations.impact: Better debugging and consistent error responses

recommendations.title: Remove Duplicate Code in MCP Tools
recommendations.description: Similar boilerplate across tool implementations. Create base tool class.
